Aero 1.2.6 adds **Select**: search any model, click Select, and Aero runs it the best way your PC can.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.2.6_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.2.6_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.2.6-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.2.6-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## What's new

- **Select.** It's on every search result and model page.
  - Before downloading anything, Aero works out which quant and setup fit your GPU, RAM and disk: all on the GPU, experts or feed-forward weights in RAM, part on the CPU, or reading from disk.
  - It then downloads the file, tunes it and loads it.
- **Big models on small GPUs.** A 4 GB GPU with 16 GB of RAM can select a 27B model and it runs, slowly. Aero tells you the expected speed and offers smaller models of the same family. A 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model runs at about 26 tokens/s on that card.
- **Original-weights repos just work.** Aero uses the model's own GGUF version. When none exists, it makes one, or offers AirLLM when llama.cpp can't run the model.
- **No VRAM number to type.** Tuning uses your free VRAM automatically, and **Change** is there if you want your own.
- **New settings** under Model & tuning: how long Select tunes, and the minimum speed it aims for.

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
